[[File:Carreras_Major_capital_city.jpg|250px|thumb|The governor's palace]]
As of [[138 ABY]], [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Biala]] resided at the '''governor's palace''' in [[Carreras Major]]'s [[Carreras Major's capital city|capital city]]. It had at least three large rounded pyramid-like structures. That same year, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] impostor [[Darth Wredd]], who was impersonating the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Yalta Val]], visited the palace to report the death of four members of [[Carreras Major security force]] to Governor Biala. The palace was also known to have a hangar bay. Later, Darth Wredd began mobilizing Biala's security forces at the hangar bay to deal with the alleged "Sith threat"&mdash;the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Ania Solo]] and her companions.
